Loss report: gitlab -> argo
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden) is not written to the Argo file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends) is not written to the Argo file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/script script.interpolation (the script reads CI_PROJECT_DIR, which argo has no source for; the step stops with a message when it starts)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/source-checkout step.action: input git artifact at /workspace (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha workflow parameters carry the repository and the commit; a private repository needs credentials on the git artifact, which the file does not set; a private repository needs usernameSecret and passwordSecret, or sshPrivateKeySecret, on the git artifact; the file names none)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint job.env: copied into the env of every container of the set (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/script script.interpolation: variable prelude (argo does not expand variable values, so the prelude sets GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE again in the shell)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/script step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.branches
